resources.string: This accessibility service automatically detects and clicks the \"Allow USB / Wireless ADB debugging\" authorization dialog without manual touchscreen interaction. Ideal for headless devices, remote racks, and automated testing.
Auto-start on boot • Hands-free ADB authorization

When a computer connects via USB or Wi-Fi to start ADB debugging, the system displays an \"Allow USB debugging?\" dialog.\n\nThis app uses Android\'s native Accessibility Service to automatically detect the prompt, check \"Always allow\", and click \"Allow / OK\" with zero manual interaction. Once permissions are set up here, the service persists and auto-starts on device reboot!
Complete the following permissions to ensure boot auto-start and background persistence:
Used to detect ADB authorization dialogs and automatically click Allow.
Prevents Android Doze mode and OS task killers from suspending the service.
Maintains high process priority to prevent being killed by low-memory killers.
For Xiaomi (MIUI/HyperOS), OPPO, vivo, enable Auto-Start and No Battery Restrictions.
Click the button below to display a simulated ADB authorization prompt to verify that the Accessibility Service automatically checks \"Always allow\" and clicks \"Allow\".
